worldcombat.skill.bittermalice.summary: Sends out the resentment it holds as a hand that flies to the target and closes on it: the hit deals special damage and lowers its Attack. The lower the user's health, the heavier the blow; lingering mode doubles it against an afflicted target, while grudge mode is unconditionally heavier with a deeper Attack drop and devours the target's status.
worldcombat.skill.bittermalice.use.0: Cut a ranged target's physical output
worldcombat.skill.bittermalice.use.1: Turn low health into the heaviest grudge strike
worldcombat.skill.bittermalice.use.2: Finish an afflicted foe (grudge mode also strips its affliction)
worldcombat.skill.bittermalice.descripti: The grudge hand closes on the target for %1$s special damage.
Releases the grudge within %1$s blocks; it flies at %2$s blocks per tick toward the target with a %3$s block collision radius.
A hit lowers the target’s Attack by %1$s stages.
The lower the user's health, the deeper the grudge and the heavier the blow.
worldcombat.skill.bittermalice.grudge.on: Grudge: this strike is unconditionally raised to x1.35 power with a 2-stage Attack drop on hit, and its cast is slower; if the target carries a major status (burn/paralysis/poison/frozen/sleep), the hit first devours one of them, curing the target.
worldcombat.skill.bittermalice.grudge.of: Lingering: the target keeps its status, and takes x1.6 power while afflicted, but only a 1-stage Attack drop.
worldcombat.skill.bittermalice.timing: Castable within %1$s blocks; after a %2$s wind-up it recovers for %3$s, spends %4$s PP, and goes on cooldown for %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.bittermalice.growth.0: From level %1$s the grudge rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.bittermalice.growth.1: From level %1$s the grudge rises again to %2$s power and the reach grows to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.bittermalice.preferenc: On: this strike is unconditionally x1.35 power with a 2-stage Attack drop, and its cast is slower; if the target carries a major status (burn/paralysis/poison/frozen/sleep), the hit first devours one of them, curing the target. Off (lingering): the target keeps its status and takes x1.6 power while afflicted, but only a 1-stage Attack drop.
The companion only releases the grudge once the target is within this distance; larger values fire earlier and are easier to sidestep in flight.
On: enemies already carrying a status rank higher (lingering mode doubles on them). Off: ordinary combat ordering.
On: below half health the companion is more willing to cast this move (the grudge deepens and hits harder). Off: no weighting by its own health.
